bdag cag rnams la sdang bar byed pa'i dgra gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i bar du gcod pa 'di rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can gyi khams ma lus shing lus pa med pa thams cad/ bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun khro bo'i rgyal po'i bsnyen pa bya snyam du bsams la/ nga la khro bo'i rgyal po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ral gri dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil ba sku la rin po che dang klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa yin te/ rigs bzhi las gtso bo gnyis gnyis brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pas/ klu thams cad bka' rang nan gyis 'khor du 'gro ste/ 'gro ba klu'i rnam par sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sems can rnams kyi las kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa bzhi yin gsungs/ klus gzhan 'phrul dbang byed man chad la dbang byed pa yin pas/ spu ta yang srog med yin te mtsho ma dros pa bya ba ti se'i rtsa na yod pa de na bzhugs pa yin pas/ de la bzlas pa byas pas klu thams cad dbang 'dus pa yin gsung*/ yang zha btsan gyis khyer ba'i mi zhig la sne'u zur bas klu brgyad kyi rgyan gsal btab pas skad ngan thon skad pa gsung*/ spyan gcig thur du gzigs pas sa 'og gi klu 'dul ba/ gcig gyen du gzigs pas bar snang gi gnod sbyin 'dul/ sku phyi nang thams cad me dpung gis rab tu brgyan pa/ gdan nyi zla padma'i steng na bgegs brkyang skum gyis gnon pa zhig tu bsgoms la/ sku gsung thugs la 'od dkar dmar mthing nag byung nas rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim par bsam zhing*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

oṃ tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa na hūm̐ phaṭa zhes lan gsum brjod nas khro rgyal rang la thim pas rang khro rgyal tu gyur par bsam mo// de ni lung sbyin pa yin no gsung*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya de'i ched du rje btsun khro bo'i rgyal po'i bsgom bzlas byas pas sdig pa thams cad sreg gnod byed thams cad la brgyal te 'ong*/ 'bog de 'chi snyam pa'i 'jigs pa chen po 'byung snyam du bsams la/ skad cig gis rang tha mal gyi spyi bor raṃ dmar po cig bsam de gsal ba las thig le ser po sran ma'i ga'u tsam cig de las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rtse sor bzhi pa zhig bsam de'i steng du haṃ mthing nag las me khru gang tsam 'bar ba la blo rtse gtad de bzlas pa bya/ yang dmigs pa bar ma la spyi bor me bsgom pa yan chad sngar dang 'dra ba la/ me de la me stag dmar phro phro 'phro yin thur du 'bar bas rang gi lus mgrin pa snying ga lte ba ma lus par thul gyis tshig nas khro rgyal du gyur te/ lus phyi nang thams cad mer 'bar ba dang bcas pas bzlas pa bya/ gsum pa gzhan sngar dang 'dra/ rang skad cig gis khro rgyal gyi pad nyi'i steng du snying hūm̐ du gyur pa de las/ 'od zer me lce dpag tu med pa byung nas lus gang nas ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'phros pas khro bor gyur pa de rnams kyang ri rab tsam ma tha yang gnyis phu sha steng tsam gsung*/ yang hūm̐ las lus kyi nang nas me ba spu'i bu ga na phar tsha zhing 'bar ba bsams te/ phyi nang me'i gur chen pos gnod pa dang sdig pa thams cad bsreg cing bzlas te 'di'i dus su gnod pa chen po byung na/ ngag tu sngags bzlas shing yid kyis bsngo ba byed dgos par 'dug ste nged la de ltar byung gsung*/ sne zur pa'i zhal nas dmigs pa gsal ba kho na gal che ste de yod na bgegs phyi'i rgya mtsho'i phar 'gram du 'bros par 'dug pa la/

mi gsal na sngags bzlas kyang drung du lad mo bzlos par 'dug gsung*/ yang dmigs pa gsal na nags me'i nang du chu phor gang gtor bas gnod mi nus pa dang 'dra la/ de med par bzlas pas rgya mtsho'i nang du rdo tshan cig bcug pa dang 'dra gsung*/ lar gnod byed de la zhe sdang gis a ti thum thum zhes drag sngags rgyab pas mi thub ste/ gnod byed kyi zhe sdang de nyid byams snying rjer bsgyur bas/ de ltar gyur te ngas 'di gcig pus mdze sos pa la grangs mi chod gsung*/ des na chos gang na mod pa de rnams zab pa yin pas gces spras su mdzod cig gsung*/ yang bla ma rin po ches thugs rje chen po khro bo'i rgyal po lhan skyes gsum dpag tu bsgoms pa de yin/ gtum po sum rtsegs kyi man ngag bya ba yin gsung*// // 612) ༄// thos bsam sgom pa mthar 'byin pa la bla ma gal che bar gdams pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ thos bsam sgom gsum mthar phyin pa la shes rab can chos kyi rjes su 'brang ba paṇḍi ta'i lugs dang*/ dad pa can gang zag gi rjes su 'brang ba ku sā li gnyis las/ nged ku sā li yin te bla ma gal che bas rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas/ snying rje chen pos sdug bsngal gyi khur chen po 'khur bar nus pa/ shes rab chen pos gzhan gyi lam sna 'dren par nus pa/ tshe 'di la ltos pa skra'i rtse mo tsam zhig kyang med pa zhig dgos pa yin gsung*/ de yang rang ma ltogs ma 'khyags pas slob mas mi tshor te mtho dman mang po mi zer te rang dang bde skyid mnyam du spyod pa zhig dgos/ de yod kyang shes rab med na mi phan pas pha shan pa'i bu sdig la sbyor ba dang 'dra bas shes rab dgos te/ sems mi gnas pa gnas pa/ gnas pa brtan pa de bogs 'byin pa la mkhas pa/ dang po bdud mi 'jug pa'i thabs la mkhas pa/ zhugs na bzlog pa la mkhas pa zhig dgos te/ de yang lam rgyus yod pa zhig dgos te nyams su myong ba rtogs pa rtogs nas kyang grol ba zhig dgos te/

rdo rje gdan du 'gro ba la phyin pa zhig dgos/ kha g.yo mkhan gyi rjes su 'brangs na 'phan yul gyi grogs po sho re ra yang mi thon gsung*/ de yang tshul bzhin du byed na rab tu byung nas chags pa thams cad spong dgos pa yin/ shākya'i rgyal pos sngon rab tu byung ba la btsun mo lha mtsho ma dang sa mtsho ma dang*/ grags 'dzin pa gsum la 'khor nyi khri yod de btsun mo drug khri gling bzhi pa la dbang ba/ 'dod khams sum cu rtsa gsum man chad la dbang ba/ stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po yang rab tu gshegs te/ sprang por zhal gyis bzhes te bsod snyoms pa dbyar zla ba gsum rta chag gsol ba/ gos phyag dar khrod grong pa'i bu mo bran mo grub pa mo'i ro shun shig can bshus te gsol ba yin te/ spyir dge slong dgon pa ba bya ba shing drung du bsod snyoms blangs nas bzhugs/ spyil po yang min te bla gab med pa'am/ dur khrod pa bya ba zas gos lhung bzed/ dur khrod kyi 'tsho ste byin len yang ji ltar 'ong ngam/ de bzhin du sbyangs pa'i yon tan la brten nas bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dang po'i rnam rtog kyang yod mi rtog pa yang yod pa/ rtog pa dang bcas shing dpyod pa dang bcas pa ste/ bzhi pa la btang snyoms yongs su dag pa'i dran pa bya ba thob nas/ bsam gtan gyi rten nam nyer bsdog gzugs khams kyi gzhi'am gzugs med kyi gzhi yang skye ste/ rten de la brten nas 'chi dang skye gnas shes pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul dang lha mig dang rna ba'i mngon shes thob kyang rigs drug tu skye ba mi 'gogs par bshad de legs pa'i skar ma'am/ de ltar zhi gnas gcig tu grub pa yin te shān ta de bas kyang*/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// zhes pa lta bu yin te/ sems mi gnas pa gnas pa/ gnas pa brtan pa/ brtan pa bogs 'byin pa yin te lhag mthong zhes pa yang*/ tshangs pas zhus pa las rang gi sems nyid kyi gshis mthong ba zer bar 'dug ste/

de yang lam rim gy-i dbang du byas pa yin/ cig car ba so so'i skye bo 'ching ba can zhig tshig bzhi pa zhig thos pas stan de'i thog tu mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bsgres mos zhus pa na/ lus rgas pa sdug bsngal zin pa de yang spong mi nus pa sangs rgyas kyis dngos su lung bstan 'dug gsung*/ de lta bu de bla ma la rag las pas bla ma yang rkos phor la ri mo med par tsha tsha la ri mo mi 'byung bas byin rlabs can zhig dgos gsung*/ de yang bla ma yon tan med pa la dad gus byas na yang bla ma de la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes zhugs nas byin gyis rlob nus par 'gro ba'am/ gzhan theg pa chen po'i bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig dang phrad par byed pa'i byed pa gnyis 'jug pa yin gsung*/ 'di la gsung rab na bzhugs pas bram ze mi gdung ba bya ba/ gzugs mdzes pa dad pa dang shes rab che ba zhig gis slob dpon bram ze nor bu bzang po bya ba la rigs byed slob tu phyin pa la/ slob dpon gyi chung ma mi gdung ba la chags pas slob dpon rgan po gzhan du skrad nas/ 'di dang nga gnyis cis kyang 'khrig pa spyad dgos snyam nas gos bzung ba la/ kho bla ma la dad pas 'dod pa ma bsten pa la mo khros nas gos hral/ lus sen rjes su byas khri zhig po zhig gi rtsa na bsdad nas/ slob dpon gyis ci nyes byas pa la nga la mi gdung bas 'di ltar byas pas khyod kyis 'di ngan par gtong dgos zer/ 'di shes rab can mkhas pa glo bur du ngan par gtong du mi btub thabs kyis btang dgos zer nas/ dus lan zhig nga la rigs byed gzhan la ma bstan pa zab pa zhig yod de bsgrub par nus sam nus/ mi stong bsad na tshangs par skye ba yin zhes bla ma'i zhabs la gtugs nas mi yod pa'i sa phyogs zhig tu/ ral gris mi dgu brgya dgu bcu go dgu'i ske bregs lus la khrag gis byugs sor mo la phreng ba byas nas yod pa la/

mas da phrug rkyang pa yin pas bus brtul zhugs spyod pa la kha zas sbyin du phyin pas/ ma bsad la kha blang snyam nas ral gri khyer ba la/ sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i dus la bab par gzigs nas dge slong du byon pas ma btang nas/ sangs rgyas bsad snyam pa je ring je ring la 'di thams cad mkhyen pa yin pas grol ba'i thabs yod dam snyam nas gri bskyur nas chos zhus pas/ stan de la dgra bcom pa'i 'bras bu thob pa yin te/ 'di la mi de rnams bsad pa'i rnam smin gyis dmyal bar yug cig phyin pa yin zhes zer/ sdug bsngal dar cig kyang 'byung kyang zer te/ kho lam log pa ston pa'i bla ma la dad pas kyang yang dag pa'i bla ma dang phrad pa yin gsung*/ yang dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas la dad pa med kyang bla ma dam pa zhig la dad na don 'grub la/ sangs rgyas la dad kyang bla ma ngan pa zhig la ma dad na yang sangs rgyas kyi yon tan 'gegs zhes/ bla ma rin po che gsungs gsung bar gda'/ yang bla ma de rnyed pa dang grags pa chos brgyad la dga' na bla mar mi btub ste/ nor 'di phul ngas chos zab mo 'di 'chad zhes tshod byed pa yin te/ chos bshad nas nga la ja sig dang dar 'bog bskur zhes pa de tsam la tshong zer ba yin/ ming gzhan du bsgyur bas mi phan/ mi 'di bslus shig yon bdag gyis zhig spyan drongs/ zhabs tog gyis zer tshong gi ming bsgyur ba yin mod/ des na tshe 'di la spu rtse tsam zhig kyang ma 'khris pa zhig dgos gsung*// // 613) ༄// phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes pa gsum gyi gdams pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ yang gshis lhan cig skyes pa/ lam lhan cig skyes pa/ 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa gsum du yod pa las/ dang po ni sems can dang sangs rgyas la bzang ngan med par ye nas yod pa de yin te/ rgyu gnyis lam bla ma dam pa'i rkyen gyis yod pa de ngo sprad nas bsgom pa de yin/ de gnyis su med pa'i don der bzang ngan spang blang re dogs thams cad zhi zhing thim pa de la zer ba yin te/

gsar pa kun snyam na dge sbyor 'dod 'dod du bya'o cig tu byed/ der ro stod je gzer snying je mi dgar 'gro ba yin/ 'di sngon rje rin po ches kyang legs rab 'dug bla mas kyang 'di legs pa yin no zhes ngo sprad nas yod pa yin gsung*/ phyis bla ma grongs/ sgrub pa zhig rings thabs lam las yon tan thams cad 'byung*/ phyag rgya chen po la mi 'byung ba snyam nas de btsal nas bsgoms pas/ rtsa rlung gi nyams skyes nam mkha' stong pa la 'ja' zhig kyang byung ba la bsgom du byas/ phyis rtsa ba shor nas med/ grub thob sgom gang la zer cha med pa yang byung*/ phyis mi la thug pa mthong gsung*/ rang la dge sbyor yod pa de zhe 'dod kyis ri dang brag la rtsol ba bskyangs pas nyams mtho dman skyes pas dga' ba la sgom du byas/ mi dga' ba'i dus sgom med pa yang 'dug go gsung*/ des na bla ma rin po ches thos bsam la yid ches par dka' bas nyams shig bskyed nas skyes pa dang*/ 'jig pa dus mnyam du mdzad par 'dug gsung*/ yang dbang po rab tshan gcig la dang po nas nyams med par cig car du skye ba yang yod/ dbang po rab tshan gcig la nyams bzang po skyes nas/ bla ma la mos gus byas pas dag nas 'gro ba yang yod/ lar gnas pa la gtsor mi mdzad gsung*/ 'di la sngon 'phags pa gro zhun skyes rna ba bye ba ri bya ba la/ rgyal po gzugs can snying pos/ yang na rin po che'i phung pos chu bo gaṅgā bsgyur/ yang na bu nga'i drung du phyag la thong zhes pas/ phan ri chu rin po cher bsgyur bas chog bu mi gtong zer ba la/ bus pha la rgyal po de nga la phan par byed pa yin pas nga thong zhes zhus nas phyin pas sangs rgyas la rab tu byung bas drug sde khyim bdag phyug po'i bu/ mar gsar gyi gong bu 'dra ba 'di lta bus brtson pa mi nus zhes pa dang*/ khos kun dga' bo la gdams pa zhus pas 'chag pas don 'grub zhes pas/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal du 'chag sa byas te skor ba 'ba' zhig gis rkang pa'i lpags pa zad de/

rus pa la thug pa spu gser mdog kyang zad nas ting nge 'dzin ma rnyed nas/ nga rang babs sam snyam pa la sangs rgyas byon nas gro zhun skyes kyi pi wang gi rgyud grims pa las skad 'byung ngam lhod pa las 'byung*/ ran pa las 'byung ba de bzhin du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos thams cad kyi rtsol ba dang mi rtsol ba gnyis las mi 'byung ste/ sor bzhag pa las 'byung zhes pas kho dgra bcom pa thob pa yin/ sang sgom min pa kun kyang mi brtson pa dge sbyor la gtan blo mi 'gro ba de min gsung*/ rtsol ba tung tung de yang min te/ byang chub sems dpa' gang la yang mi brtson de ni brtson zhes pa dang*/ rje 'ol ka ba'i rtsol ba brtson 'grus smyo zhes pa de yin gsung*// //

614) ༄// mnyam gzhag rjes thob gang gis 'gro don byed pa sgom chen rnams la dris pa// na mo ratna gu ru/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ sgom chen pa rnams la dri rgyu zhig yod pas/ mnyam par bzhag pas sems can gyi don 'ong ngam ma bzhag par rjes kyis byed soms dang*/ mnyam gzhag gis byed pa yin te grub pa thob pa'i brgyud pa gong ma de rnams kyis kyang mnyam gzhag 'ba' zhig gis sems can gyi don byas/ sa dang po nas bcu'i bar gyi yon tan brgya phrag bcu gnyis la sogs kyi 'gyur kyang*/ mnyam gzhag la brtan pa cher thob kyi gong du 'phel ba yin/ sangs rgyas la mnyam rjes med pa yin/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas rnal 'byor pa rab seng ge lta bu yin/ 'bring ri dwags lta bu gzhan gyis bsnyen bkur du med pa de yin/ tha ma rgyal po lta bu gsung ste de mad par 'dug gsung*/ yang rje rin po che'i zhal nas sgom chen pa rab sangs rgyas/ 'bring byang chub sems dpa'/ tha ma nyan thos yin gsung*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas kyang sgom chen pa ro gcig rtogs pa rnams gzhan du phyin tsam na/ nad dang sdug bsngal mi mthun phyogs zhig byung tsam na thabs gzhan mi bsten dgos/ de rang phyag rgya chen por 'ong ba yin gyi gsung*/ de rang la sbyor rjes kyis zin par bya zhing thug phrad du bzhag pas bogs thon gegs sel thams cad 'ong ba yin gsung*/ de bzhin du rgyal po dpe kar klu bsen mor gtogs pa thams cad kyang gcig shos su 'ong ba yin pas/ yi dam gyi lha thugs rje chen po'am rje btsun mar 'ong ba yin gyi/ ma zha ma'i zhal nas/ sgoms kyin zhen pa mi ldog pa// thod ka'i chos nyid go lags sam// gsung*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas kyang*/ gnyis med thug phrad kyi rang bzhin la// mnyam rjes gnyis kyi 'dzin pa dag /gsung bas/ de lta nas nad dang gdon la de ltar goms pa des sang nas gnad gcod dang dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal la sogs pa thams cad la yang de bas dka' ba zhig med kyi de 'dra ba 'di na mang po yod pa gsung*/

yang sgom chen pa sems rtsa ba dang bral zer nas lta kham nam mkha'i 'brug tsam gtong ba rnams nad dang sdug bsngal zhig byung tsam na/ pag shi dang gsus pa logs logs su song nas rkyen mi thub pa yin te/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems yin gsung bas/ sems las ma gtogs pa'i logs pa med/ snyam du thag lta bas gcod grub thob gong ma'i bstan bcos dang mdo rgyud zab mo blta gsung*/ de ltar byas pas 'khor 'das thams cad sems skye med du chod nas ye shes kyi bogs kyang thon pa yin gsung*/ bsgom med pa kun gyis kyang de ltar mos pa bya zhing gsol ba btab gsung*/ yang thug phrad du 'jog pa 'di la nyon mongs kyi rigs tsam la mi btub pa'i skyon yod de/ drug rtsa ba dang nyi shu nye ba'i nyon mongs pa skyes kyang sngon du byams snying rje lam du btang la de thengs pa dang*/ de nas thugs dam gyi ngang la thengs pa dang de ltar ma byas na skyon bsam gyis mi khyab gsung*/ yang rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa bya ba nad kyi rigs su gyur pa brtul nas ting nge 'dzin du zhugs pa la zer ba yin gsung*// // 615) ༄// srid zhi'i bde legs yon tan thams cad rten 'brel la rag las pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ rje rin po che'i zhal nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi bde legs dang yon tan thams cad rten cing 'brel ba 'byung ba la rag las pas/ snod kyi 'jig rten mkha' la rlung brten de la chu'i phung po brten pa'i tshul gyis yin pas/ dmag sogs 'di thams cad sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs/ chos skyong gi mthu dang nus pa las byung bas/ chos skyong rang gang yin snyam na dri za'am grul bum mam yi dwags sam/ gshin rje gsum gcig tu 'gro ba dang*/ klu gnod sbyin ste rgyal phran bzhi rgyal po chen po bzhi brgya byin te tshangs pa dang stong gnyis bar ma dang*/

stong gsum gyi rgyal po tshangs pa dang gzhan yang dmag sogs kyi grogs byed pa rgyal po chen po bzhi dang sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha dang*/ rab byung la sogs kyi grogs byed pa tshangs rigs kyi lha dang*/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las thams cad la gya nom snang dang 'og min gyi bar gyi gtsang ma rigs kyi lha lnga/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas min na theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig mang du bzhugs pas grogs byed pa yin te/ dmag la sogs sangs rgyas dbu 'phang bstod pa la rab byung brgya'am stong gis kyang ma yin/ lha dang mi lha ma yin du bcas pa dang rgan po skyel thung byed pa dang*/ byis par thum por 'tsho ba tshun chod kyang dmag tu 'gro ba yin te/ mdor na sho pa mig che 'di bas pa dang 'dra/ de 'ong ngam du 'od dam bco brgyad 'od kha rje kha dang 'dra bar/ bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyab tshan po che dang 'brel las 'byung ba yin pa/ de ma yin pa rang gi 'dod khas mi 'ong bas/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur dkon mchog gi mchod pa/ chos skyong dang 'byung po'i gtor ma rgya chen po byas nas gsol ba btab pas 'byung bas/ de yang byams pa dang snying rje rgya ma chad pa phyogs ris med pa'i chos kyi sku 'di la gcig tu chud pa zhig dgos te/ de lta bu zhig yod na yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya bar 'ong ste/ srid rtse'i sems can nas mnar med yan chad chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu chud pas/ de gcig pu'i ston pa yin snyam pa so so'i snang ba la 'char bas/ de lta bu'i bla ma gal che ba yin te da res ma lus pa thams cad grogs kyang bcol/ don yang 'grub pa yin pas gtang rags dang chos skyong rnams kyi bsngo ba yang bya ste gal che gsung*/ da phyin chad khyed rnams kyis kyang bya ba dang byed pa ci byed pa thams cad la/ dang por sems bskyed pa dang chos nyid rnam par dag pa bsgom pa/ snying po phyag rgya gsang sngags kyi bzlas pa la sogs pa gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin du byas na/

zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las gang byed pa thams cad 'grub pa yin pas de ltar bya/ bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang chos skyong lha mi thams cad kyis thugs la btags pa'i drin thams cad snying khong du bzhag la bka' drin rjes su dran pa'i mchod pa dang*/ bsngo ba byas te bsngo ba 'di dgod re bro ba zhig yin te gzhung mi 'jug pas ras chod du 'gro'am ste/ bka' lung bzhin sngon sme ru'i grong khyer bya bar mi ma yin thams cad kyis 'breng ba yin 'dug pa la/ der bram ze bde byed kyi tshong khang chen po byas nas sangs rgyas 'khor bcas byon pas de'i yon bshad bsngo ba mdzad nas gda' ba la tshigs bcad gcig 'dug pa 'dzin ma khom/ jo bo bka' gdams pa'i sangs rgyas ye shes ltar phying khug na yod gsung*/ bla ma dkon mchog yi dam thams cad kyang mdun gyi nam mkha' la dmigs/ srid rtse nas mnar med yan chad kyi lha dang mi dang chos skyong rigs drug gis bsdus pa thams cad kyang sngon du dmigs la thal mo sbyar la bsngo ba bya'o// bdag cag gi tshe thog ma med pa nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog mchod pa chos skyong spyod pa/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur ba dang*/ phyin chad sangs ma rgyas kyi bar tshun chad du yang byed par 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub tu bsngo ba yin pas thugs gtad de/ 'di thugs dam dang rjes su 'brel ba yin no// da res ngas dge 'dun la dri ba zhig bya yi/ de ltar bsngo ba'i bdag po de rang gang yin da bzlo gsung*/ nga na re de mi gda' ba zer bas rang mi gda' zer te/ de yang*/ dus gsum bdag nyid bde chen bla ma ni// khyab bdag gzugs can ma yin 'gro 'ong med// zhes sogs de yin te/ 'di 'o skol gyi bla ma rin po che'i 'di kho na yin/ sngan chad kyang ma byung phyis kyang mi 'ong ste/ 'o skol thams cad bla ma yin gyi bla ma khams pa gcig pu yin pa min/ 'o skol khong gi bu yin pas/

de la gcig tu gyur pa'i bsngo ba yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa las kyang*/ chos kyis chos la nam yang mi bsngo shes gyur na// zhes pa de lta bu yin no// bka' gdams pa rgyas 'debs te de yang sangs rgyas phal po che nas bshad nas 'dug ste/ de bas der song ba 'di ngo mtshar ba yin pas 'di nged pha spad kyi khyad chos yin/ yang gsol 'debs kyi bsngo ba 'dis nga la bogs chen po byung bas byin rlabs shin tu che ba yin pas kyang bskyar la bya'o gsung*// // 616) ༄// dam tshig dang sdom pa med par 'bras bu byang chub mi thob par bstan pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ rje sgam po pa'i 'das mchod kyi dus su de ring dge 'dun rnams la chos zab mo zhig 'chad/ do nub nas nga mtshams gcod pa yin zla smad 'di la gsung*/ de 'o skol dam tshig dang sdom pa 'di kho na gal che ste/ so so thar pa'i dbang du byas na dge slong gi nyis brgya lnga bcu/ dge tshul gyi bcu 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis lan cig phyir 'ong mi 'ong*/ rgyun zhugs dgra bcom 'bras bzhi 'byin/ byang chub kyi sems smon 'jug gi bslab bya ma nyams pa gzhir bzhag pas bla na med pa'i byang chub/ gsang sngags kyi dang po gzhi dbang gis smin par byas te/ khas blangs kyi don grol lam bskyed rdzogs sgom pa gzhan don mtha' dag byams snying rje skyed pa bsgoms pas 'grub/ rang don phyag rgya chen po bsgoms pas 'grub ste/ de ltar dbang dang bskyed rdzogs kyi don la brtan yang dam tshig med pa'am ma bsrungs na 'bras bu mi 'byin te/ dper na shing sdong rtsa ba nas bcad pa la lo 'bras gtan skye mi srid pas/ bcu bzhi bco lnga yan lag dang bcas pa 'di rnams kyang gshin rje dgra nag dang dus 'khor gyi rgyud nas 'byung ba yin gyi/ rta dbyangs kyis ni sdebs pa yin te/ de ltar rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig ma nyams na 'bras bu rab tshe 'dir 'ja' lus/

sems chos kyi skur 'gro ba dang*/ 'bring grub chen brgyad/ mtha' ma zhi bas nad zhi ba'am dbang gis rang gi nye gnas dang bud med mi la mi 'chor ba dang*/ drag po ye shes pa'i bsnyen pas 'jig rten pa bcug nas dgra gsod pa la sogs pa 'byung gsung*/ mkha' spyod ni rje btsun pa ṇi man chad rta mgrin gnod sbyin mo yan chad bsgrubs pas/ des 'khur nas mkha' spyod dam 'og min nam sum cu rtsa gsum du'o// mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma zab pa dang rgya che ba'i don zhu ba po brgya byin/ rje btsun ma pham pa lta bu la gdams pa zhus te lus des sangs rgya bar 'dod pa'o gsung*/ de rnams zhar byung yin/ da khyed dge 'dun la dgos pa'i chos zab mo zhig yod de gang yin snyam na/ phyag rgya chen po skye ba med pa spros pa dang bral ba zer/ rkyen gang skye ba med na ji ltar med zhes pa zhig 'chad pa yin/ 'di la mkhas pa rgyus yod pa zhig dgos tshul du 'dug da lta dang phyi ba dang*/ zho rdze'u kha cig gis chos thams cad skye ba med pa yin byas kyin 'ud btang bas chog par 'dug thos bsam legs par byas pa'i mkhas pa rgyus yod/ bla ma yon tan can mkhas pa zhig ma yin par tshig tsam du skye ba yin byas pas 'ong 'ong mi 'dra/ dang po thos pa ma byas de nas bsam pa ma byas pas mi rtag pa bsam pa kun ngan pa ngas skye med bsams pa yin byas na/ rmongs pa rnams bden snyam ste skye med bsam pa dang bral ba'i smra bsam brjod med yin pas kho la rgyus med de/ yul zhig na rgyal po zhig la mchod gnas rig pa'i gnas lnga pa zhig yod pa'i drung du bram ze zhig gis gnas lnga rung ste/ ngas rig pa'i gnas brgya shes byas pas lnga pa btang nas de la mchod pa byas pas lnga pa na re/ gang na rgyal po blun yod pa// de na bram ze rigs brgya ba// kha dang smra yi bye brag med// zhes pa lta bu yin/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos thams cad rang gi sems yin/

de skye ba med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu ste/ des na/ bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes// bdag gzhan cha la 'dzin dang sdang*// zhes sogs te 'jig tshogs lta bar bshad pas/ de gnyis 'dzin gyi rnam rtog mkhan slob tu bzung*/ de nas de brtags te de rang gi sems kyis rang btags pa las gzhan btags pa med/ des na gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar gyi chos thams cad kyang rang gis bzung ba yin/ lam lnga sa bcu sangs rgyas dang dmyal ba yang rang gi sems yin te/ de jo mo zha ma'i zhal nas/ chos can thams cad rang dag la// 'di la dngos 'dzin ga na rigs// zhes pas gzugs gzugs kyis stong pa yin no gsung*/ des na khyed kyis phyag rgya chen po 'di la bstod cing bsgom rnam rtog 'di brtags/ da rnam rtog 'di kho na ma brtag pa zhig bcol/ da zla phyed nga'i rnam rtog sdug pa 'di bsgom mo// phyag rgya chen po bsgom re mna' bya'o gsung*/ de ring gi bsngo ba de yang mi byed tshig yin/ de gzung 'dzin rnam rtog yin gsung*/ de ring gi chos 'di phyag rgya chen po la 'phrig tshud pa kun snyam na da rung de'i yang dpag na zhig yod dam snyam/ ma tshud pa kun snyam na ji 'dra zhig la zer snyam pa kun la phan du re/ 'phrig 'ong du re nas bshad pa yin gsung*/ mtshan nyid pa 'di las zin med de/ long ba ma ki la 'di na gzim spyil/ 'di na nag tshang*/ 'di na mchod khang*/ 'di na kyang 'u 'u bya ba las go ba ye mi 'ong gsung*/ skyes bu kun dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge sbyor byas pa 'di ltar 'di dang 'di snyam pa'i mngon mtshan med kyang brtsis la thebs dus zhig yod de/ mi de lha 'dre mi gsum gyis ma tshor snyam yang brtsis la thabs dus shig yod pas shi med ko med du dge sbyor bya'o gsung*// // 617) ༄// dge sbyor ri khrod du 'phel yang bogs 'don bla ma'i drung du byed dgos pa// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas rje rin po che dang rje sgam po ba'i zhal nas/

slob ma sgom chen pa kun dge sbyor ri khrod gcig pu la sogs su 'phel yang bogs de bla ma'i spyan snga kho na che gsung skad na/ de ring chos zab mo la 'khang bar gda' bas zab pa zhig bshad ces/ rta khor grub thob kyi 'bul ba'i nyin par rnal 'byor pa la gsum ste/ nged snyam na rje rin po che'i rgyal por yod pas rab yin snyam tsam na de min par 'dug ste/ rab 'brug lta bu sgra che la mthong ba med pa de yin par 'dug ste/ skyes bu kun 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad de rang gi bsam pa de ji ltar bsams pa de bzhin du 'ong bas/ sgom pa yon tan 'od dang po sdig can las rab tu byung ba'i bsam pa byung ba de'i rkyen gyis rab byung de yang bsam pa/ spyil por bsgom pa sgom chen de yang bsam pa/ dpon slob dang dge bshes su 'ong ba yang bsam pa yin/ de bzhin du dang po phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams ma lus pa'i don du sems bskyed/ de nas nged gsang sngags pa'i lugs kyis bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pa la bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa yin te/ snod gzhal yas khang*/ bcud yi dam gyi lhar byas te bsam pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig tu bcug nas/ bzlas pa byas pas de thams cad smin pa dang grol bar nus te 'di tig tig yin/ khab mig tu skud pa 'jug pa 'dra ba yod te tshegs cho le 'dug pas ngas sgrung zhig bya yis de go bar gyis/ rje sne zur bas nad pa zhig la khro rgyal du bsgoms pas shin tu 'jigs par byung*/ de nas klu brgyad kyi rgyan bsgoms pas skad ngan chen po byung ste/ des na phyag rgya chen po go ba kun klu brgyad bya ba med zer nas las stabs byed 'dres khyer ba yin te/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir chu klung ji snyed cig 'bab pa/ ma dros gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po de'i mthu dpal yin te/ klu chung thams cad bred nas 'gro bar gda' ste/

byin rlabs byed tsam na klu gsal bar bsgoms te/ nga snyam na sbrul kha phyi blta nang blta la yang khyad yod snyam gsung*/ des na bsam pa'i dkyil 'khor cig gis rab 'byams ma lus pa mtha' med pa'i sems can thams cad smin pa dang grol ba gtub pa yin te/ bsam pa yin pas sems can gyi yang khams rgyud gcig yin/ dus gsum du byung yang lus mi 'dra ba len pa las/ des na sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang sems can thams cad dang bsam pa'i ting nge 'dzin gcig gi nang na 'khyam ste/ 'o na lam gyi yon tan 'di rnams mnyam gzhag yin nam rjes yin na/ 'o skol rje 'bangs zhig yin pas 'ong bar thal te mi 'ong*/ bsam pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig gis mnyam gzhag thams cad 'ong ste chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba/ mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad mnyam gzhag yin te sangs rgyas kyang bsam pa yin/ dper na byams pa gang la yod pa de shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten rdul med na/ phar 'ongs kyang thams cad kyi phar 'gyur te/ kun gyis bu'i bya ba byed pa yin/ da lta pha la byams pa yod pas bu'i snying du sdug te/ skyes bu blun pa de lta bus kyang mi 'ong ba'i tshul du 'dug gsung*/ yang spros pa gdams pa re re'i rjes su 'brangs te rtsa rlung dang 'bad rtsol la sogs pa'i nyams za zi dang*/ 'di ltar byas na 'di ltar 'ong la sogs pa'i byung zin yal zin pas mi de thams cad chus khyer nas yod pa yin pas/ nyan thos kyi dbang du byas na bden pa bzhi kho na yin te/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po 'dir skye bar byed pa'i rgyu gang yin dris/ mi re res re khyer nas 'ong ste mi mthun nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa ma lags sam/ 'o skol rang theb sgyel mdzub sgyel yin no// de yang zhe sdang gis dmyal ba/ 'dod chags kyis yi dwags/ gti mug gis dud 'gro/ de spong ba lam spangs nas med na 'gog pa yin pa la 'di na gnyis/

zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gnyis las bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin gang zhig gis nyon mongs pa de zhi bar nus pa de yod pas lhag mthong ma yin/ lhag mthong de nyid rang rtogs tsam min pa// gang gis rten cing 'brel par 'byung*// chad pa med pas rtag med pa// 'gag pa med pas gnas med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// zhes pa'am/ 'di la bsal bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// zhes la sogs pa dang*/ sgom pa po med bsgom pa med// lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin// stong pa nyid kyi zhes sogs dang*/ gzugs stong pa'o// stong pa nyid gzugs so// shā ri'i bu de lta bas na chos thams cad stong pa nyid de/ mtshan nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma dang bral ba med pa/ bri ba med pa/ gang ba med pa'o// zhes pa ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad 'dir sbyar bas chog des na thams cad gzung 'dzin yin te zhe sdang gis na rakaḥ 'dod chags kyis yi dwags/ gti mug gis dud 'gro/ dge ba bcus mi/ de'i steng du byams pas lha/ snying rjes tshangs pa'i gnas/ mi rtog pas khams gong mar skye ste/ zhi gnas rang du skye ba min de med pa zhi gnas su mi skye/ des na nyon mongs pa med de ngan song du mi dge la sogs med na lha mir mi skye/ zhi gnas med na khams gong mar mi skye ste/ de tsam na sangs la rgya rgyu med de bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas kyang*/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi khyad par las// rtogs tsam nyid na ma rtogs pas// sangs la rgyas dang ma rgyas med// gsung ste/ de thams cad 'dzin stangs shig yin/ phyi rol gyi yul 'di kho na gtan la 'bebs te 'di ltar pheb phebs mi 'dra/ bla ma rin po che sgam po pa'i khyad chos 'di la gnyis med de/ 'dzin pa 'di kho na ngo shes bzung sgrog rang brdal la 'gro sa yod par gda' ba/ de yang nga la bde ba dang ldan par bsgoms pa zhig las mi 'ong ste ma lus pa la bsgoms pas thams cad kyis mthong ba dang thos pa dang*/

smin grol du 'gro ba yin pas/ de yang bsam pa mi nyag gi rgyal po chos byed la phan 'dogs pas de ltar 'ong ba de yang bsam pas mthu byed kyis/ 'di nas khams su sbyor ba byas pas 'chi ba yang bsam pa yin/ slob dpon dza bo na re mal gror dge bshes don stengs pa'i zhal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' kun bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i ting nge 'dzin las mi ldang ba yod de/ des ci byed snyam na/ de sems can thams cad smin grol byed pa yin gsung ste/ de yod ngas go bas/ gcig pur sgrub pa byas na sems can gyi don 'grub ste rab yin pas 'di bya gsung*/ des na gcig pur nyams su len pa des 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad bsam pa yin pas/ bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par byed pas de ltar 'gyur ba yin te kun tu rgyugs pa zhig gis don mi 'ong ba yin par 'dug 'bring ri dwags ni gnyis gnyis kho na yin te chags lam pas las rgya/ grol lam pas lag bde lta bu yin te de gnyis su yod na grogs shes/ bzhir song nas ngan pas 'bod thos tsam du bsdad nas srog gi mthud ma byed pa yin te/ des kyang mi 'ong bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa yin/ nga mi gcig dang 'grogs shes tsam yin ngan nga rang gis khur/ bzang kho la ster bas gzhan gyis mi shes/ mi ngo dmar po bsrung cing nag gsung*/ bla ma rin po che kho bo mtha' mar rgyal po lta bu yin gsung gsungs/ khong la rnal 'byor pa'i ming med sprul sku gdul bya'i don byed pa yin gsung*/ skabs 'dir ngo sprod de la sne zur ba'i bsgrub pas kyang*/ byang chub sems dpas lam mnyam gzhag yin nam rjes yin zhes pa de go ba che ba zhig byung*/ des na chos thams cad la mi 'thad pa sbyor ba 'dra ba zhig dgos pa yin te/ tshad ma ba'i khe shags kyis 'thad pa la ci gtang*/ sgrub pa po gsang sngags kyi sgor zhugs pa la tshe 'di nyid la lus ngag yid gsum/
yi dam gyi sku gsung thugs su 'gro ba 'thad de khyed la mi 'thad/ tshul khrims can la nyon mongs 'gags pa 'thad de 'chal ba la mi 'thad gsung*// //

618) ༄// dwags po chos bzhi'i don 'grel snying bsdus bstan pa// yang 'di skad du gsung ste/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ stong gsum gyi 'jig rten rin po ches byur bur bkang nas dkon mchog gsum la phul ba bas chos tshig bzhi zhig bshad pa bsod nams che ste/ de'i gnad ka yang 'jig rten gyi rin po che la sogs pa thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ste/ sangs rgyas sras dang nyan thos rang rgyal lha rnams dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bde skyid chos rnams ji snyed pa// de kun shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog las 'byung*// zhes pas so// de la rje mtha' rtsa ba'i zhal nas/ rje sgam po ba'i 'das mchod kyi dus su kho bo gong gi chos thams cad 'chad pa yin te thog mar yang*/ mchod pa thams cad rab spangs nas// bla ma mchod pa rab tu mchod// de mnyes pas ni zhes pas 'o skol kyang gong gi tshogs chos kho na yi ger bris te nan chag byas/ khrom du phyin pa'i dus su yang zhal gyi dkyil 'khor mthong sar bsdad nas/ yan lag bdun pa re re gnyis gnyis gsum gsum nyin gcig dgu phrug grub pa zhig kyang byas/ res long med pa yang byung*/ de bzhin du kun tu bzang po rnam 'phrul gyi mchod pa yang byas te/ nged la bla ma rin po che de la khams nas sangs rgyas yin snyam pa yod de 'dir yang sangs rgyas pas ci nye tsam du blo bcos ma dgos pa byung ste/ 'das mchod kyi zla ba'i tshogs chos sngon ma/ chos chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba/ lam gyi 'khrul pa sel ba/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba bzhi po 'di gsung*/ de la dang po 'o skol gyis tshe thog ma med pa nas byas pa'i dge ba thams cad tshe 'di chos brgyad du song bas chos su ma song ste mi rtag pa ma bsgom pas lan te/ rang bas rgan pa'am gzhon pa shi ba la bsams te/ bdag kyang 'chi ba yin snyam du bsams pas tshe'i bya ba thams cad bor nas/ phyi ma phan chad kyi bya ba 'ba' zhig min pa long med pa zhig 'ong ba yin te chos su song ba yin/

phyi ma mtho ris kyang tshangs pa dang brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur ba'i bde 'bras thams cad kyang las kyi dbang gis sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las ma 'das pas/ las 'bras la yid ches pas thar pa thob par 'dod pa nges 'byung ste chos lam du song ba yin gsung*/ so sor thar pa yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs pa 'gags pa'i zhi ba de tsam de nyid la yun ring du gnas pa la nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas zer te logs pa med pa'i lam/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i bsam pa ste/ 'khor ba las nges par 'byung ste lam gol de lta bu zhig tu blo sbyong ste/ theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la// theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas// zhes pas de lta'i lam gol sa med de/ lam gcig tu sbyong ba ni lam gyis 'khrul pa sel te/ 'khrul pa nyid ye shes su 'char ba yin te spang bya dang gnyen po gnyis med de/ gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams la// zhes sogs dang*/ tog tse ba'i zhal nas/ tha mal shes pa snying gi dkyil du sad// zhes dang*/ dngos po thams cad dang bral bas// phung po khams dang skye mched dang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs// zhes pa dang*/ sgom pa po med bsgom pa med// lha med sngags kyang yod ma yin// zhes pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ rtogs ma rtogs gnyis las ma gtogs pa// 'bras bu la thob ma thob med// ces pa ste/ 'khrul pa rang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bcu gnyis te/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis rga shi'i bar de nyid dang ye shes su shar ba las byas pa'o// stobs kyi ye shes su song ba yang med/ ye shes kyi thog tu brlan te bzhag pa yang med byung ba yang med de/

nyams myong dang rtogs pa gcig tu mchi zhes pa yin te/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid la rtogs pa byas/ bde gsal mi rtog pa nyams myong byas te gcig tu 'dres nas/ dbu ma pha rol tu phyin pa/ gsang sngags na yod pa dang mthun pa 'dra ba yod de/ de yang khams bde rten rtog yod pas 'o skol phyag rgya chen po rang rnam rtog dang nyon mongs pa rang yin no// 'o na rtogs pa yod pa skye ba len nam mi len zhe na de yod na las kyi stobs kyis skye ba mi len pa sa dang po'i bden pa mthong bas/ smon lam gyi stobs kyis skye ba dang*/ sprul pa'i skye ba blangs nas ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du sems can don byed par 'dod pa yin te/ bla ma rin po che'i skyes rabs lta bu gsung*/ sngon nga la til dro sgom gyi bgro gleng byed pa zhig la gsum po de gang la len nam mi len 'dri zhes pas/ nga rgyal nas mang skol zhig kyang thob gsung*/ de ltar mi rtog pa bsgoms pas 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad du ma song ste phyi ma phan chad kyi rtog pas chos chos su song*/ las rgyu 'bras dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs kyis 'khor ba'i bde ba/ srid rtse man chad la yid phyung ste thar pa 'ba' zhig gi rtog pas chos lam du song*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas bla na med pa gsum du rtog pa 'khrul pa yin te/ gcig tu shes pa'i lam gyis 'khrul pa bsal te/ theg chen 'ba' zhig tu song bas lam gyi 'khrul pa bsal/ 'khrul pa ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar du rten 'brel bcu gnyis yin te/ ma rig pa nyid rig pa'i ye shes su shar bas 'khrul pa ye shes su shar ro gsung*// // 619) ༄// rtsa rlung gi gdams pa kun phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa'i thabs su bstan pa// yang bla ma rin po che'i gdams pa zhig bya yis nga'i sgom phrug dang mkhan po'i sgom phrug min pa gyis gsung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas gang la yang nges pa'i shes pa brtan po gal che ste/

rje mi la gtum mo/ rngog dang mes gnyis rmi lam/ pu to ba skyes bu gsum/ spyan snga ba bden pa gnyis/ rje sgam po pa dang mtha' rtsa ba gnyis stong pa nyid dang snying rje la thugs nges pa dang*/ rang dang gzhan gyi bya ba thams cad kyi don bsgrub pa yin te/ de khong gnyis kyi bu yin pa 'dra/ de la mos pas nga khams nas 'ongs tsam na/ chos drug gi grub thob min nam rung ste snyam nas/ su la 'phrad du dge slong se ba la dris pas/ phyag rgya chen po'i grub thob yin zer bas/ sangs rgyas gnyis ka'i 'du shes skyes gsung*/ skyes bu chos 'di la 'phrig cig tshud dgos/ ma yin pa rtsa rlung dang rtsa'i rgyal po a ba dhu tī dang rang bsgom kyang mi phan te gsung*/ rgya gar gyi grub thob kun kyang birwa pa khong rang la nang lam 'bras bu skyes/ nā ro pa chos drug tu skyes/ des gzhan gyis yang don 'grub pa yin pas/ de slob ma snying dang 'dra ba la mi ston na su la ston te/ snyigs ma'i dus su slob ma zer ba rang la nas khal brgya byin kyang dka' gsung*/ de la ngas 'bri gung du srung ba sum cu dang gegs sel bshad nas/ sngon nga la yang ma phan da khyed la yang mi phan byas pas/ mkhan pos gsan nas nga la yang de ltar byung med gsung ste/ mdor na rang gi nyams myong rgyud la skyes pa zhig dgos pa yin/ ngas bogs 'don dang gegs sel bya yis de la rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel 'di gsung rab nas ji skad gsungs pa bzhin yin te/ kha cig nas 'dod chags kyis gtso bo byas pa'i mi dge ba bcus yi dwags/ zhe sdang gti mug gnyis kyis dmyal ba dang dud 'gror bshad/ kha cig gis mang pos dmyal ba/ 'bring pos yi dwags/ nyung ngus dud 'gror kyang bshad/ des na rgyu de dang de la chags/ rten 'bras bu de dang de 'byung ba chos nyid yin/ yang bla ma'i gdams pas lam la zhugs te/ sbyor ba'i dus su ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral ba nas sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blo skyes na lam de nyid bsgoms pas 'bras bu goms pa mthar phyin na de ltar 'gyur ba chos nyid yin/

'o na de ltar bsgoms pa las nyon mongs pa chags sdang rmongs gsum dang bla ma dang ma dad pa dang*/ nad dang sdug bsngal gyi rnam rtog sna tshogs 'ong ba ci yin snyam na rin po che'i zhal nas/ a mo gha pa sha'i rgyud las/ gang tshe dngos grub 'byung ba'i tshe// de tshe las kyang ldog par 'gyur// zhes pas bde ba'i sna sdug bsngal gyi rnam rtog sna tshogs 'ong ba ci yin/ rang la lam du bla ma la bshad pas rtsa rlung dam grib bam ting nge 'dzin nam/ lam du slong ma shes par phyi la gzhan la hab dgad byed cing nye gnas la sogs la bshad pas/ de la bar song nas phyis kho log lta skyes te bla ma rang mthong ba tsam gyis mi dad par 'gro ba yin pas shin tu gsang gsung*/ de kho na lam du byed pa yin pas bdag la nad lta bu zhig byung na/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bdag gi 'dis dag par gyur cig zhes snying thag pa rus pa'i khong nas lan gsum mam gcig gam sum cu rtsa gsum du brjod cing*/ thun cig bzlas pas de'i rlan 'ong ste dang po thun gcig gnyis la kho rgyal ba tsam/ yang bar pa la gsum la 'dzing 'bal snyam por 'ong*/ mtha' mar de las rgyal nas gar song cha med du 'ong ba yin te/ bzlas pa dang klog dang mo chog gis mi dgos te byams snying rje la sogs kyi dge sbyor gyis blang ba'i bde sdug de rang la bsgoms pas 'dag pa chos nyid yin/ de bzhin du lha bsgoms pas de ltar byung na yang lha de nyid nad kyi zug gi dus su shin tu yang gsal bar 'ong ba yin de rang gis 'dag pa yin/ 'di kun 'o skol la nyams myong tig tig yod pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyang de ltar gsungs pa yin gsung*/ de bzhin du rang gi sngar dge sbyor de rang la btud cing bsgoms pas nad dang zug rngu gar song cha med du 'gro ste nyams myong yod gsung*/ phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa yang nad de nyid chos sku yin par lhan cig skyes sbyor bshad pa/

chos sku spong ba dang snying du 'dre zhugs sam de ltar bzlas pa'i tshul du ngag gi 'khor lor grub pas phyis 'bad med du grub te/ de ma yin pa'i jo bo skyo la me dang khrag byas na phan nam zhes 'dres khyer kun zer ro// des na ngan pa byung tsam na bzang po zhig 'byung ba yin/ bzang po zhig byung ste bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams shig byung tsam na nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog sna tshogs yang 'byung ba yin te/ bla ma zhang yang dngos grub sngar rkang mgyogs grub pa la zha nas de'i 'og tu grongs pa yin gsung ste/ 'di ltar bla ma'i mos gus ma btub na yang mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad kyi mos gus ma btub pa thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad 'dis dag par gyur cig zhes kha 'don du bya'o// de ltar ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mos ma'i mgo la rgyab pas lcags khang du mgo la gsor 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal byung bas/ sems dran pas bdag gi 'dis dag par gyur cig snyam pas shing ta la bdun srid du nam mkha' la gsor 'phags gsung bar gda'o// // 620 ) ༄// byang chub kyi sems rin po che 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i dpes bstan pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas chos gsang ba zab mo zhig nyan na sngon la rang gi dge sbyor de dran par byas nas de'i ngang las nyan pas ngo sprod du 'gro ba yin/ nan chags kyis tshig 'dzin pa min gsung ba de ltar mdzad gsung*/ tshes gnyis kyi nyin par rje mtha' rtsa ba zla ba 'di'i tshes bco brgyad tshun chad chos gsung nas/ sang rtsa thus shig de nas chos bya yis zhes pa la/ de nas zhag 'ga' na 'das pa'i bcu bdun gyi nyin par 'di gsungs te/ sgom chen rnying pa kun chos de las zab pa sngar yang ma byung ste ji ltar yin nam zer/ deng sang yi ger bris pa yin chos bco brgyad sang bshad kyis gsungs/ 'jig rten na 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po zhig yod na rin po che sna bdun med mi srid/

de ma yin pa la yod mi srid pa dang 'dra bar/ rgyal po dang 'dra bar pha rol tu phyin pa'am/ dbu ma'am/ do ha la sogs pa spros med lhan cig skyes par zer/ don dam pa byang chub sems zer ba de gang yin snyam na rang gi rig pa 'di la zer ba yin/ de la kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems rin po che sna bdun dang 'dra ba 'di med mi srid de/ de gnyis gcig kyang don gyi ldog pa yin pas/ dper na rgyal po la 'khor lo rin po che yin min tshes bco lnga'i nyin par gso sbyong gi dus nam mkha' la gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa zhig byon te lag gis blangs nas phul bas/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can thams cad la phan bde dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba la 'god nus pa dang*/ de bzhin du bkod nas byang dang nub dang lho phyogs la sogs pa'i gling bzhi pa'i sems can thams cad la 'god nus pa dang 'dra bar/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa des kyang sems can thams cad dkar po dge ba'i rtsa ba la 'god nus pa dang*/ yang glang po rin po che kha dog thal kar mche ba drug pa mdun mtho ba/ mgo srog chags 'dam bu chu shel gyi mdog ltar dmar ba de rin po che yin/ rgyal po mgo la bzhon 'dzam bu gling pa'i sems can rnams rgyab tu khur nas sems can de rnams bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral ba'i las bsgrubs/ shar phyogs lus 'phags su phyin nas de thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral bar byas nas/ gling bzhi pa'i sems can de rnams rgyab tu 'khur te/ de bzhin du nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan rgyab tu 'khur nas/ steng gi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral bar byas te 'khur ba bzhin du/ kun rdzob byang chub sems yod na/ 'di ni nyan thos/ 'di ni rang rgyal/ 'di ni bla na med pa zhes gsum du rim pas sems bskyed par/

theg pa chen po 'ba' zhig tu khur nas sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral bar byed pa dang*/ dmag dpon nam khyim bdag rin po che ni yin min rgyal pos dus rings pa rings pa grur zhugs te/ 'dir nga la longs spyod 'di dang 'di dgos byas pa dang*/ phar 'gram du bgyi'o zhes pa dang 'di rang du dgos zhes pa na/ khyim bdag gis bla gos phrag pa g.yas su gzar/ pus mo btsugs te rgya mtshor phyag gnyis brkyang bas gter chen po brgyad 'brel nas byung ba la/ rgyal po gang dgos pa spyod la mi dgos pa mtsho 'di nyid du zhog ces pa lta bur/ kun rdzob yod na/ byang chub sems med rgyal 'byung 'jig rten yod med na// 'bras bu brgya byin tshangs pa nyan thos ga la 'byung*// zhes gsungs pa ltar sems can thams cad kyi bde ba dang legs pa'i dpal thams cad 'di las 'byung ngo*// dmag dpon gyis phas kyi rgol ba 'joms pa bzhin du dgra bcom pa bya ba yin te/ byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin yod na/ dgra thams cad srid du chod nas 'ong*/ gnyen lta ci smos te/ sangs rgyas kyis bdud dmag bye ba dung phyur byams pa chen po'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bcom pa yin te/ rin po che'i zhal nas kyang*/ gnyug ma byams chen gyi ting 'dzin gyis/ srod la bdud kyi dkyil 'khor btul// zhes pa lta bu yin te/ ngas myang po la dmag drangs pa dang 'dra gsung*/ de ma yin zhe sdang gis dgra mi thul bas/ khams kyi rong po dang zla shod kyi rim 'bye gnyis 'thab pa la/ rim 'bye cig zin pas srog kha khung kha phye nas sgyu ma'i nang nas snying 'tshol zhing*/ dgra lha gyis byas pas dgra sri byed zer/ srog lha gyis byas pas phung sri byed zer te/ snying gang na yod byas pas khyod khyi rong gi snying sgyu zhabs na yod pa yin nam/ nga'i snying pau che brang 'og na zhes te zhe sdang gi dgra mi thul gsung*/

blon pos legs nyes kyi gros thams cad byed pa bzhin du byams snying rje la gros dris na gros la nyes pa'i dogs med pas/ rje rin po che la ngas tshigs bcad mdun gros byams snying rje gnyis la 'dri bya ba yang byas gsung*/ rta mchog rin po che yin na rgyal pos bzhon nas khe bsus kyi bar du gling bzhi'i sems can thams cad bde legs la 'god pas/ dus de'i bar la 'khor ba bzhin du byams snying rje yod na sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par byas nas/ byang chub rin po che myur du thob par byed gsung*/ btsun mo rin po che ni ha cang mi ring ha cang mi thung*/ ha cang mi dkar mi nag mi dmar ba/ kha nas utpa la'i dri bro ba/ ba spu'i khung nas tsan dan gyi dri 'byung ba/ 'gro ba na yang thams cad kyis blta na snyam du sems/ 'dug na dang 'greng na yang blta bar 'gro na snyam du sems/ grang na reg pa tsam gyis dro bar nus/ tsha na reg pas bsil bar nus te/ de bzhin du kun rdzob yod na skyid pa dang bde legs thams cad 'byung zhing*/ nad dang gnod pa mi mthun pa byung na yang sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal dag pa'i rgyur 'gro bas/ rgyu'i dus na de ltar bsgoms pas 'bras bu mthong thos thams cad du sman bsil grib dang dpag bsam gyi shing du gyur nas/ sems can thams cad kyi phan bde grub ste/ de ltar yang ded dpon mdza' bo'i bu mo dang 'dra gsung*/ nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po 'khor mang ngam nyung yang rung ste sgron ma'i bya ba byed pa dang*/ rgyal mtshan la btags nas gsol ba btab pas ci 'dod pa 'byung ba bzhin du/ kun rdzob yod na rnyed pa 'dod pa yang*/ rta dang glang po dang gser dngul dang*/ grags pa 'dod na yang byams pa dang snying rje chen po bsgoms pas rgya dkar nag la thos nas 'gro/ snyan pa 'dod na yang snying rje chen po bsgoms pas nga la mdang zhag snying rje chen po'i mi kha byung ste byams pa las byung ba yin mod/

zhe sdang gis khong gi mkhar lcog 'gyel byas nas bla ma de zhe sdang can yin zer nas 'ong*/ khyed kyis snying rje can yin byas kyang mi phan/ snying rje chen po'i phye 'gam dgos pa yin/ sngar gyi phye gtor byed pa la yid rang de ltar byed pa smon pa yin te/ phye dang bstod ra gnyis gcig pa yin te/ phye gzhi yod pa la bstod pa'i gzhi yod pa yin gsung*/ de ltar don dam byang chub kyi sems dang kun rdzob gnyis kyang gcig pa yin te/ spros pa rab zhi don dam byang chub sems// snying rjes rab brlan kun rdzob smon 'jug gnyis// til dang til mar lta bur ro gcig pa// zhes pas 'di bsgom dgos pa yin/ nga la chos 'di gnyis las dpag na yang med nga rang yang 'di bsgom/ gzhan la yang 'di ston pa yin pas nan tan chen po mdzod/ rgyal po chen po de'i gnas dbyar bsil ba dgun dro ba/ ston dpyid snyoms par bzhugs pa bzhin du/ don dam pa sems rig pa'i rgyal po de bzhugs sa bzhin du bzhugs pa yin te/ gsang sngags yin pas khrom bshad byar mi btub gsung*/ de'i bsngo ba zhig bya na dus gsum la dge sbyor gyi thog nas bltas pas dus gsum la dmigs pas/ dus gsum dus med rtogs pa po/ ste rtogs pa bzang por 'ong gsung*/ bco brgyad kyi nyin chos mang po ma gsungs te zab par gsung*/ sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsung pa yang lta sgom spyod gsum du 'dus te/ lta bya lta byed thams cad dang bral ba/ bsgom pa nyams myong thams cad dang bral ba/ spyod pa byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems su bsdu ba dngos gzhi'o// 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid shes pa la// de la mya ngan 'das zhes brjod// 'jam dpal gyi zhing bkod pa las/ 'jig tshogs la lta ba ni chos kyi dbyings so zhes pas/ lta ba chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba de 'bras bu chos sku/ bsgoms pas longs sku/

spyod pas sprul pa'i sku thob gsung ngo*// snang srid 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad sems yin pas/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang phal po che las/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khams gsum po 'di sems tsam mo zhes/ sems can de ni sems ni 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan rnams kyis kyang*/ ma gzigs mi gzigs gzigs par mi 'gyur ro// ma byon pa dang da ltar gyi sangs rgyas kyis gzigs par mi 'gyur ro gsung*// //

621) ༄// tilli pa'i phyag rgya chen po tshigs bcad ma'i dgongs don 'grel ba// tilli pa'i lta ba yang*/ kye ho// 'di ni rang rig ye shes te// ngag gi lam 'das yid kyi spyod yul min// zhes pas sems tsam pa kun skyengs pa yin skad/ de ltar sems yin pa gnyis ka de'i gnad kas sbyin pa gzhan la btang bas longs spyod rang la 'ong ba go'am/ de gnyis med kyi gnad yin/ de bzhin du zhe sdang gzhan la skyes pas dmyal ba rang la 'ong ba dang 'dra ste/ shānta de bas/ lcags sregs sa gzhi su yis byas// zhes pa dang*/ de lta bu dang grub thob rnams kyi snang ba bsgyur bar nus kyang rang yin pas gnyis med pa'i don no// des na sangs rgyas kyang sems can la thog mar sems bskyed pas sangs khong rang rgya ste/ sems can sangs rgyas la drin che gsung*/ des na rang gi don 'ba' zhig tu yod pa yin te/ lha sgra seng thung gis nga la ras kyi gos shig byin pa dgra la 'chor snyam ste/ spos dkar byas nas gzims spyil du phul bas mi kun 'thab ste/ nga bong gu che gon pa yin byas te/ da lta nga la yod pa 'di yin mod/ des na rang bas gzhan gces byas pas rang gces par 'ong ba yin te/ ngas gzhan gces pa ltar byas nas za ma bra bar gzhan la byin pas/ gzhan gyis kyang za mi bra 'thung mi bra bar nga la ster bar gda' ba/ de bzhin du bla ma dang grogs po mgo brdungs pas kyang khong gi mgo la e phog ci cha/ rang mgo brdung bar 'ong ba yin te/ des na 'khor 'das thams cad rang gi sems skye ba med pa stong pa nyid yin te/ 'khor ba 'khor bas stong*/ mya ngan las 'das pa mya ngan las 'das pas stong ste/ stong par song ba min ye nas stong pa yin gsung*// // 622) ༄// kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad bsam pa'i dkyil 'khor yin pa// yang 'di skad du gsung ste/ mkhan po zhang chen po'i bla dbye thang gi las chos la de ring gi de la mi zhig 'phrig cig byung nas 'dug pas las chos zab pa zhig bshad kyis gsung*/

bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ yai shes rang snang gnod sbyin ri mo ltar// gcig la mkhas na kun la chags thogs med// zhes pas/ 'khor 'das thams cad bsam pa'i dkyil 'khor yin tsam na/ bla ma'i bzhugs sa dang dge 'dun gyi bla dbye thang kun kyang gtsang ba mnyam pa phul bas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhabs mthil dang mnyam pa bya ba thob par bshad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhud pa na ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyang dma' zhum byed/ gcong rong rnams kyang nam mkha' la zhabs 'degs pa de lta bu thob gsung ste/ rtag tu ngus chos 'phags kyi sku la rdul gyis mi gos pa la khrag gi chag chag btab pa lta bu ste/ kho'i lus sangs rgyas thob pa de kun phangs pa yin/ 'o skol gyi ngan song du 'gro ba 'di cis phangs gsung*/ des na bla ma dang grogs rdo rje'i spun rnams la zhe sdang chen po skyes/ phyogs thams cad du dmar kham gyis song tsam na/ zhe sdang mnyam pa nyid du song ste/ dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du song nas de rnams dmyal bsrungs su 'ong ba yin/ 'dod chags mnyam pa nyid du song ba'i dus su yi dwags kyi 'jig rten du song nas chu bo chen po gaṅgā'i drung du phyin kyang skom hub zhig kyang med par 'gro ba yin/ gti mug mnyam pa nyid du song ba'i dus su klu chen po lus ri rab tsam pa rang gi sha rang gis zos kyang mi tshor ba'i dud 'gro chen por skye ba yin pas/ byams pa mnyam pa nyid dang*/ snying rje mnyam pa nyid dang*/ byang chub kyi sems mnyam pa nyid bsgom dgos pas/ de ltar tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang bde ba can gyi 'jig rten la sogs par skye ste/ rang gi bsam pa'i dkyil 'khor gcig las med pas/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang sa dang lam gyi rim pa thams cad kyang bsam pa yin pas/ chos thams cad spros pa med pa nam mkha'i dkyil lta bur ro gcig tsam na/ ya mtha' bla ma dam pa rnams nas ma mtha' bshang lci'i srin bu yan chad ro gcig tu mnyam pa nyid du sbyong dgos pa yin/

sbyong bar bya ba stong pa kun kyang la la stong*/ la la zug gzer du byung na ma 'byongs pa yin pas sbyang*/ des na khyed snyam na don dam pa skye med yin te/ kun rdzob 'di rnams ci yin snyam na/ bla ma rin po che la yang ngas brgya tshar gcig thos khyed la yang kha byang byang du bshad pa yin pas/ kun rdzob kyi chos 'di rnams thams cad bsam pa'i dkyil 'khor yin pas mnyam pa nyid du sbyong ba yin gsung*/ de ltar byas na rang yang rje btsun spyan ras gzigs pha rol tu phyin pa dang*/ 'jam dpal dang bla ma dam par 'ong ba yin pas bla ma'i mos gus gyis/ de ma byas par nga'i mgo brdungs kyang de'i mgo 'di kun ri'i rgyal po ri rab las mtho bas e brdungs ci cha/ nga khams gsum gyi mis mi thub gsung*/ mdor na bla dbye thang dang bla ma dge 'dun gyi bzhugs sa mnyam pa la sogs pa ma grub pas/ de'i dod po sa'am rdo'am me long gi maṇḍal yang mnyam pa 'bar 'bur med pa phul bas/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams sam padmo can gyi zhing khams su skye gsung*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas bsgom spros bral skyes pa rnams shar phyogs rdul dang bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams su dge slong sha mdangs sngo ba zhig gi drung du skye/ ro gcig skyes pa rnams sangs rgyas kyi zhing rdul dang bral ba byang chub kyi snying po'i bkod pa bya bar/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod rgyal po sman gyi lha bya ba'i drung du skye/ phag mo gru'i bya wang dang srog chags 'di rnams kyang kho'i gdul bya der skye gsung ste/ de la mi 'thad pa med mdor na sems can dmyal ba'i skye gnas na shi 'phos nas lhar skye bar bshad nas gda' ba/ byams pa chen po'i mthus phag mo gru'i bya wang dang srog chags 'di rnams mi la blo 'bebs lugs la ltos dang*/ de ltar yin nam snyam na gzhan zangs ri'i bya wang kun mi mgo mthong ba dang bros par 'dug des na bdag nyid chen po des dge slong bye ba khrag khrig mang po dang*/

sems can bye ba khrag khrig mang po smin pa dang grol bar byas shing phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la bkod pas gdan sa 'di rnams ngo mtshar ba'am yon tan dpag tu med gsung*// // 623) ༄// bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog par dge 'dun gyi bya ba shin tu zab pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas chos bshad bshud la sogs pa de zab pa min/ de'i sngon du 'gro ba dge 'dun gyi bla dbye thang shom pa dang*/ chos khri brtsigs pa dang*/ shing khral chu len pa la sogs pa bsod nams kyi chos 'di tsho zab pa yin/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags na ye shes kyi tshogs stong pa nyid du 'ong ba yin/ sa gzhi snyoms dang maṇḍal 'bar 'bur med pa 'di/ mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa'i rgyur 'gro/ bde ba can nam padmo can du 'gro ba yin te/ zhe sdang mnyam pa nyid du skyes na bla ma dang mkhan po dang*/ pha ma thams cad kyang dmyal bsrungs 'ba' zhig du 'char/ de bzhin du 'dod chags kyis yi dwags/ gti mug gis dud 'gro phrag dog gis lha ma yin du 'char/ yang byams pa mnyam pa nyid kyi sum cu rtsa gsum dang dga' ldan la sogs par/ lha'i bu dang bu mo la sogs pa snying du sdug pa mang po dang lhan cig tu skye/ snying rje dang dga' ba dang btang snyoms kyis kyang lha gnas gong ma de rnams kyi snang ba 'char/ shin tu dag pa mnyam pa nyid ni 'khor 'das thams cad skye med chos kyi skur sems kyi dkyil 'khor gcig tu mnyam par bya ba de ltar rtogs dgos pas/ bla ma'i mos gus gal che ste bla ma 'di 'khrul/ rtsab rtsub re mang snyam du bsam du mi rung*/ 'di la bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dgos pa chen po yod pa yin te/ bod la 'pho ba dang grong 'jug nus pa rje mar pa chen po khong las med/ rgya gar na bram ze chen po sa ra ha las ma byung skad/ de ras chung pas rgya gar du dris pa la/ de lta bu'i grub thob chen po de la dgra'i gnod pa mi 'byung ba'i don du/

srog mkhar bzang po zhig bu slob rnams kyis bzhengs te/ de zhig pa'i re'u hrul la yang mi la'i rdo rings bya ba 'dug lo// de ltar bu slob rnams kyis sgal pa bud bud du rdo bskyal te/ bla ma'i srog la brtsis mdzad pas da lta 'o skol gyi brgyud pa 'di la gar 'dug kyang*/ mi dang mi ma yin gyi 'tshe ba dang bral te khong gi sku drin yin te/ dgos pa de lta bu yod pa khong gis gzigs pa yin/ yang 'jo ber ston pa bya ba mi chen zhig bla ma rin po che'i spyan sngar dge sbyor yang yod pa la/ phyis shes pa 'khrul ba la kho la dge sbyor yod dam zhes pa la bzang po yod de shes pa mi 'khrul kha med/ nga'i bla ma 'di mdzad spyod sna tshogs 'di lta bu re 'khrul na snyam pas 'khrul pa yin gsung ste/ bla ma la mos gus gal che/ nga zangs ri la yod pa'i dus su/ dpon re dang*/ shes rab 'od dang*/ zla grags dang*/ 'khor 'ga' las med de/ nga la mthong phyag gyis byas pas khong phyad de las ma btub/ phyis bla ma dpal chen po rtsa ri bas byas pas de ltar song ba yin te nga mthong phyag gi brgyud pa yin/ phyag dang shing dang*/ chu dang spyi las bag re min pa nga khyed la 'bul ba'i re ltos ni ma byed/ mi byed na yang khyed la gcig shos mi ster te go'am/ nga la da phan sems 'ong ba yang srid de sems can gyi las la sangs rgyas kyi mthu rdug nga kham po che rang yin khyed rnams gcig kyang med kyang nga'i za 'thung mi 'chad/ de'i phyir na nga 'khor chun che ba yin gsung*/ des na de thams cad kyi gnad snang ba rang gi sems yin te gnyis med pas bzang byas na yang rang la byas pa yin te/ rang gis rang ma khrel ba zhig byed dgos pas rang mi mang po'i dpon dang bsnyen bkur 'dod na bla ma'i zhabs tog dang*/ g.yog dang khri brtsigs pa dang gdan shom pa dang*/ phyag kyang spyi bo sa la gtugs pa yan lag lnga sa la lhan par byas na/

spyi bos nyon mongs pa gti mug dag nas rnam par snang mdzad thob ste/ de bzhin du yan lag bzhis kyang rigs bzhi'i nyon mongs pa bzhi dag nas rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas su 'gyur gsungs pas gus par bya/ de bzhin du mchod pa lnga yang de kho na bzhin rgyun chad pa med par dbul te/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags bya ba oṃ badzra puṣpe hūm̐ zhes badzra ni rdo rje ste skye ba med pa spros pa'i mtha' brgyad thams cad dang bral ba'i don yin gsung*/ sngon ngas bla ma rin po che la rta 'theng gcig phul bas ma bzhes pas phyis grongs pa na/ rta rin bu zhon 'ga' khong rang gi dgongs pa grub thob bu slob 'di rnams yin snyam nas/ rtsa ri ba la sogs la bu ram du byas shing drangs/ bla ma'i spyan sngar byams snying rje smin phrag bsdus shing bsgoms pas/ phyis nga la rta rang yang mang po byung*/ rta 'ba' zhig gis sna drangs nas de tsam byung ste/ de rnams thams cad kyang phan bde'i rgyur song ba las nga'i rtas gnod pa bskyal ba med gsung*/ mkhas pa paṇḍi ta'i lugs dang rnal 'byor pa ku sā li'i lugs bya ba 'di dang po nas med pas bzhad du 'dug bar du 'di 'dra sgrub/ rgyud nyams pas rigs pa'i rjes su 'brangs nas mi kha tshogs pa zhig byung na/ bla ma de rdol pa yin nam dam nyams yin nam rgan sprang mo zhig yin yang mi kha cog pa'i ched du bslabs te/ de la bla mar mi 'dzin te rngog lo tsā ba la tshad ma nyan pa'i dus su phyag mi 'tshal ba yin/ khyed rang tshad ma ba kun zer ba de lta bu'i zer sgros bya ba 'di zer/ myang brang 'di zer zhes pa'i mang po nga'i slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes yod par 'dod zer te ye shes la ci btub bam/ nga'i slob dpon ye shes med par 'dod zhes med pas su la phan su la gnod/ sngon sangs rgyas bzhugs tsam na yang dang por thos pa/ de nas bsam pa/ de nas bsgoms pas don 'grub pa zhig yin par 'dug ste/

'phags pa lam chung ba lta bu blo gros dman pas kyang rdul spangs dri ma spangs la thos pa'i dod po byas te 'bras bu dgra bcom pa thob pa yin gsung*/ des na de gsang sngags pa la 'di ltar byas na 'di tsug 'ong bya ba zhig rang yod pa yin pas nga brdzun che yang nga'i kha la nyon cig sgom chen pa kun 'tshol gsog bya mi dgos par/ zas nor char bzhin du 'bab pa'i thabs zhig yod kyi/ brdzun nam bden nyams su longs dang gsal/ 'o na khyed rang gi yang dgon na mi 'dug pa snyam na/ de yang bsgom pa ni med/ yang dgon byi bos gang*/ bzang shos ne'u chung ba la thug ngas kyang sngon byung ba yin pas/ dkyil krung dang mnyam gzhag byas la phyag rgya chen po la mnyam par bzhag ste/ mchu dang rkan dang lce mi 'gul bar yid kyis a nus tshad re bton te/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /khong nas 'byung ba skye ba med// tshig du brjod pa spangs pa ste// zhes pas/ lus drang ba 'khrul 'khor du bsdad pa gal che ste/ de ma yin na ar mi 'gro bas ngag du brjod pa spang dgos pa yin/ 'di la ngo sprod zad pa med pa zhig yod ngas 'dir mi 'chad/ de bshad pha rol tu phyin pa 'bum bshad dgos pas de ltar gyis dang 'tshol gsog mi dgos myong bas grub gsung*// // 624) ༄// rang snang log pa la bla ma mched grogs kyi skyon mi brtag par gdams pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos/ thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba'i chos/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste// dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// zhes pa la mi dge ltas ngan pa bkra mi shis pa mi dge ba bcu spong ba yin/ log par lta ba'i bye brag lhan skyes kyi ma rig pa yin te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyis 'joms pa yin te/ so sor thar pa dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa dang*/

gsang sngags kyi bslab pa dang sa bcu po zhig du btang ba las ci yang med/ de'i gnyen po dge ba bcu bsten pa la 'dod chags med pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba gtong ba dang*/ gtong ba chen po dang shin tu gtong ba yin/ ma chags pa zhe sdang med pa'i dge ba rang gzhan thams cad la phan bder 'gro byed dgos pa yin/ gti mug med pa'i dge ba la thos pas spang*/ gnyen pos ngo shes par byas/ bsam pas 'go mnan/ bsgoms pas rtsa ba nas spang ba ste/ de'i rtsa ba skye med du chod pa de yang goms par byas pas nyon mongs pa mi skye ba de la nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa spangs pa zer/ de'i sa bon chags sdang dang bcas pa rtsa ba nas spangs pa de la shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pa zer/ thag ring po zhig na med/ des na lam lnga sa bcu byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun zer yang*/ bsam pa'i rim pa kha cig yin pas sangs rgyas pa dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'khor ba ngan song gsum la sogs kyang bsam pa rkyang pa de rang yin te/ des na chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na rang bzhin mya ngan las 'das pa zhig zhes pa'am/ mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// zhes pa rje bram zes kyang gsung te/ des na 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad bsam pa de skye med yin te/ rje sgam po pa'i zhal nas bod kyi thos bsam pas chos 'di mi shes/ snang ba 'di cir 'dod zhes dmyal ba la tsha grang*/ yi dwags bkres skom la sogs yin te/ yin pa la sems 'dri ba ye ma byung gsung bas/ snang ba rang sems yin pas bla ma rtsi lung pas nad pa'i sngas su byon pas/ pha mas bu la slob dpon byon byas pas ba glang mgo can byung zhes pa bshad pas/ rin po che'i zhal nas de kun shin tu zab pas rang gi bla ma grogs po gza' mi thams cad kyi skyon la mi brtag rang gi snang ba log pa yin zhes gsung*/ de la bsngo ba zhig bya na 'di yang gal che ste yul dngos po bsam pa gsum po 'di 'dzom pa zhig dgos pas/

rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin pas bla ma'i drung dang dkon mchog dang byams snying rje'i sems dang ldan pa dang*/ rang gi nor snying du sdug pa phul ba dang*/ rang 'khris med pa'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa'i dus su bsngos na 'grub pa yin gsung*/ yang bla ma slob ma'i me long yin gsung ste/ de yang bla ma de la tshul khrims rnam par dag pa mthong na rang yang de ltar/ bla ma byang chub sems dpar mthong na kun rdzob tsam yang mi skye/ sprul skur mthong na rtogs pa mi skye/ longs sku'i yon tan du mthong na rtogs pa mi skye gsung*/ yang bsod nams kyi tshogs lus pa med pa'i lag rjes longs sku/ sems spros bral bsgoms pas chos sku/ smon lam rnam par dag pa'i lag rjes sprul sku gsung*/ yang bya ba dang byed pa thams cad la mig mtho btsugs te ngas 'dir ma phyin bar du/ lus lhar bsgom ngag sngags su bzlas/ yid ting nge 'dzin las mi g.yo bar bya zhes/ yang der phyin pa dang dmigs pa spo gsung*/ yang 'gro ba kun rkang mgyogs slob dpon 'phags pas smad khog med pa'i stod nam mkha' la 'phyar bar 'gro bar bsgom yang gsung ste lag tu blangs gsung*/ rje bram ze chen po'i lam la mtho tshad du mig mtho btsugs te/ lus ngag yid gsum bsgrims pas des ni mgyogs par yang 'dug gsung*/ sngon kha ba babs pas nged nyid bla bo byas pas 'khyags/ phyis so sor lus ngag bsgrims pas dro bar byung gsung*/ yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi brjod bya rang gi sems las ma gtogs pa med de/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ dper na tsan dan mer bsregs pas shin tu tsha la/ chu dang sbyar na bsil ba bzhin du/ bsam pa nyon mongs kyi blangs nas dge ba byas pas bsod nams des nyon mongs par rang stobs 'phel na lung pa khrag gi skyo mar 'gro nus par 'dug byams snying rjes blangs na lung pa phan bder 'gro bar mngon sum na 'dug pas snang ba rang sems yin mod gsung ste/

thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos su 'dug slob dpon 'phags pa'ang*/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba'i don yin gsung*/ skyes bu kun nang par langs pa'i dus su mi rtag pa/ rang bas rgan pa/ gzhon pa/ na mnyam pa gsum shi ba la blta ste bsgom/ de nas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bde 'gro la yang skyid med par go nas/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gting mtha' med pa la thar ba thob dgos te/ de yang nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas la gnas pa yin pas/ sems can kun gyis sangs rgyas thob dgos par 'dug pas de la chos gcig las med de/ thabs shes rab bam tshogs gnyis sam stong pa nyid dang snying rje gnyis zung du 'brel te gcig tu shes pas dgos pa la dkyil krung bcas nas sems bskyed bsgom pa kun gyis go /rdzogs pa mtshan bcas kyang go /mtshan med la chos thams cad skye ba med pa dngos po dang mtshan mas stong pa spros bral yin snyam du bsgom/ byas pa la mi rtag pas khyab pa de 'jig pa yin te/ lang kar gshegs pa nas/ bram ze'i khye'u bcom ldan 'das la chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin nam/ stong par rtog na rgyang 'phen pa/ de bzhin zhi ba dang ma zhi ba/ mtshan ma yod med la sogs pa mtha' brgyad ka rgyang 'phen par byas pas go'u ta ma la khas len mi 'dug ste/ smras mi btub zhes gsungs pas/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ lta ba blta byed thams cad dang bral ba/ sgom pa bsgom bya sgom byed thams cad dang bral ba/ res sgom pa nyams myong thams cad dang bral ba gsungs/ spyod pa blang dor thams cad dang bral ba/ res byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa gsung ste/ blang dor bral ba'i spyod pa de// re dogs bral ba'i lus ngag yin// tshul 'chos bral ba'i lus ngag yin// zhes pa dang*/ yang*/ seng ge dkar mo'i 'o ma 'di// gser snod dngul snod ma lags pa// snod ngan phal du blugs pa na// snod kyang chag la bcud kyang 'bo// gsungs pas/

bla ma rin po che'i chos thams cad kyi phyed byams snying rje 'ong ba 'di byas pa'i chos yin snying nas shod de byas/ dngos gzhi la rim du bsgoms te/ de ma yin par gda' bas bya byed thams cad dang bral ba'i ngang nas sems gsum po 'di gal che bar 'dug gsung*// //

625) ༄// chos zab mo stong pa nyid dang snying rje yin pa'i gdams pa// yang 'di skad du gsung ste/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ bla ma chen po zhang gi zhal nas/ mi mang po tshogs kyang nyung ngu yin la nyung ngu zhig las med kyang mang po yin gsung ba dang 'dra bar/ chags sdang rmongs gsum gyis bla ma dang grogs po la skyon sgrogs shing yon tan gsung ba de nyung*/ yang mang po yin te ling ga la gdab rgyu yin gsung skad/ mi mang yang ngas chos zab mo zhig bshad kyi/ de gang yin na stong pa nyid dang snying rje gnyis yin gsung*/ de yang khrom du mi bshad pas dbang bskyed rdzogs rtsa rlung gi mtshan bcas rnams gsang ba yin te/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi srog snying yin gsungs/ de la stong pa nyid zhes pa gang yin snyam na skye ba med pa ye nas gnas pa/ gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum rang gis stong pa ma bcos pa de la rje bram ze'i zhal nas kyang*/ gdod nas skye med rang bzhin yin pa la// de ring dpal ldan bla mas bstan te rtogs// mdun dang rgyab dang phyogs bcu ru// gang gang mthong ba de de nyid// da ni mgon po da ltar 'khrul pa bcad// da ni su la yang dri bar mi bya 'o// zhes pas de sems can thams cad kyi gzhi yod pas khams zer te/ glo bur gyi dri ma des 'bags pa de ngos phrad/ rgyus yod pas lam rtogs pa zer/ de rang thog tu phyin nas dri ma dang bral ba la 'bras bu sangs rgyas zer te/ de rtogs par byed pa la yul bla ma de rtogs pa zhig dgos te/ rkos phor la ri mo med na tshwa tshwa la mi 'ong ba dang 'dra ste gsung bas/ mtshan nyid pa kun rgol ba gtong ste kun dga' bos dgra bcom pa thob pa la 'bri rdzi'i bu slob ma sa thob zer te/ nyan thos kyi dbang du byas pa'i rgyun zhugs phyir mi 'ongs thob pa yin te/ bsgom spang gi nyon mongs pa kha cig spong ba la goms par byas tsam yin des skul ba thob pa min gsung*//

// 626) ༄// sde snod thams cad kyi mdo don rten 'brel yin par bstan pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ sangs rgyas kyi sde snod thams cad kyi don rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yin te/ 'di ltar gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla gza' skar rtsi shing nags tshal/ ri dang rtsigs pa khang khyim thams cad phyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yin/ las las grub pa yin te/ lam 'bras rlung log dang 'phar g.yo zer te nga de kun mi 'dod yon tan kyang mi brjod gsung*/ nang rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba bsam pa yin te 'khor 'das thams cad rang gi bsam pa yin pas/ shān ta de ba'i zhal nas kyang*/ lcags sregs sa gzhi su yis byas// mo tshogs 'di dag gang nas byung*// zhes pa dang*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ lcags sregs sa gzhi ngam shod kyi klung yin zhes pa dang*/ res 'og min yin zhes pa dang*/ res bde ba can gyi zhing khams zhes te/ phyi rol na don logs pa med de snang ba rang sems yin gsung*/ dper na mi zhe sdang can zhig gis mi zhig bsad na da lta rang sha gnyer ba mang po mi bde ba dang*/ lung pa khrag skyor 'gro bar gda' ba de lcags sregs kyi sa gzhi yin gsung*/ de la gsang ba rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rang gi lus yin te/ de la gnad du bsnun pas de ltar 'byung ste/ zhe sdang can de skyes pa dang bzhin dmar po sa gzhi yang dmar phrug gis 'gro ba gda' ba/ rtsi rgyal pos ka ba tsam zhig la brten nas 'pho ba'i stobs kyis mtshams med lnga byas kyang 'og min du 'gro ba lta bu yin te/ 'di gsang sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rten 'brel yin/ gsang ba rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba bya ba yin te/ sa dang po'i bden pa mthong nas bar do dang po'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gags nas/ bsgoms pa'i 'od gsal dang chos sku'i 'od gsal gnyis 'dres pas spang bya bag la nyal gyi rtog pa bcom pa la/

bcu gcig kun tu 'od kyi sangs rgyas bya ba yin te sangs rgya ba yin gsung*/ rnal 'byor pa lus rgya grol bas sangs rgya gsung*/ yang bstan pa zhig la ston pa gnyis mi 'byung ba ni bon 'bum na 'dug de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' na mi 'dug gsung*/ 'dus pa rin po che tog nas 'og gi 'jig rten dang steng la sogs na sangs rgya ba mang po bshad gsung ngo*// // 627) ༄// byang chub thob par byed pa la zhi lhag gi ting nge 'dzin gnyis dgos par bstan pa// yang 'd-i skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par byed pa la zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi ting nge 'dzin gnyis dgos te/ zhi gnas rab tu ldan pa'i lhag mthong gis// zhes pa nas/ 'jig rten chags pa med la mngon dgas 'grub// zhes pas/ zhi gnas kyi rgyu tshul khrims spong ba bdun 'khor dang bcas pas/ nyon mongs pa spong bdun 'khor dang bcas pa spangs pa'i lag rjes shul du bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum skye/ der bla ma'i mos gus skyes pas mngon par rtogs pa mthong lam skye ste sa dang po'i bden pa mthong*/ de goms par byed pa sgom lam nyon mongs dang rnam rtog phra ba'i spangs pa la sangs rgyas zer ba yin gsung*// // 628) ༄// lam 'bras kyi gegs sel bogs 'don gyi gdams pa mdor bsdus// yang 'di skad du slob dpon zhang dbus pa'i zhal nas/ lam 'bras kyi gegs sel ba dang bogs 'don pa nyams su blangs pas zab par byung ba 'di kho na yin te/ mdun gyi nam mkha' la rtsa ba dang brgyud pa'i bla ma gdan nyi zla padma seng ge'i khri la bzhugs pa la/ phyag dang mchod pa yud kyis phul la/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer dpag tu med pa byung nas bdag gi shes pa mtho dman nam lus kyi na sar bstim pa'am/ yang na bla ma rang yang bstim pa ni bka' brgyud kyi bla mas byin gyis brlabs pa bya ba yin te/ de nas rang la bstim pa'am mi dmigs par bya/

yang lhag pa'i lha mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs te tshul snga ma dang 'dra ba ni lhag pa'i lhas byin gyis brlab pa/ yang tshogs kyi 'khor los rnal 'byor pa dam tshig can mnyes par bya ste/ phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro ma dmar gtor gyis mnyes par byas pas phyi nang gi mkha' 'gro mas byin gyis brlabs pa/ rten 'brel zab mos byin gyi brlabs pas/ bka' mdo rgyud zab mos byin gyis brlabs pa/ grogs chos rgyus can dang*/ mtshams bcad pas shes pa btson du bzung bas 'dus pa lta bu la snang ba sna tshogs kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ ltad mo lta bu'i yul gyi bdud rtsi brdeg gsung*// // 629) ༄// zhe sdang rang bzhin med par bsgom pas zhe sdang gtan med 'gro bar bstan pa// yang rin po che'i zhal nas kha sang nga zhe sdang skyes pas de'i grib kyis nga na nas shin tu sdug pas dmyal ba rang du song gsung*/ de yang 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas zhe sdang gi sa bon bag la nyal yod pa la/ mi zhig la 'di re mi 'thad snyam pas rkyen byas te zhe sdang spyug rtser skyes pa'i sdug bsngal gyis na ste/ de las yin te des na rgyud la zhe sdang gi sa bon bag la nyal yod pa de rkyen gyis spyug gis skyes pa kun nas ldang ba yin te/ lus ngag du ma thon pa la nyon mongs pa zer/ thon nas las zer te dmyal ba yang de rang yin/ de bzhin du 'dod chags dang gti mug kyang de bzhin te/ zhe sdang yang med pa yin skye sa'i yul yang med pa yin te/ skye ba'i bsam pa yang med pa yin te/ rkyen las de ltar skye ba gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes pa yang de yin te/ yang rnal 'byor pa zhig lung stong du zhe sdang skyes pa la rkyen yang med zhe sdang yang med bsam pa yang med par go tsam na/ yang yang skyes kyang zhe sdang gtan med du song rdzun pas phyis rkyen dang phrad kyang mi skye ste/ de la zhe sdang skye ba med pa zer ba yin te dmyal ba'i sgo khegs/

de bzhin du 'dod chags dang gti mug kyang rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel pa zab mo yin te 'o na nga'i zhe sdang skyes pas sdig pa dag gsung*// // 630) ༄// yon bdag cig gis gser khri phul ba'i dus su gsungs pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ gnyis kyis gser khri phul ba'i dus su 'di shin tu ngo mtshar che ba'i 'bul ba yin te/ 'di'i dus su 'di phal gyis mi thub pas rang bsrung ba gal che ste/ ma bsrungs na sku khams mi bde nyen yod pas de la bsrung ba byang chub kyi sems kho na yin pas de la gces spras su bya/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub kyi sems las byung ba yin no// ngas dbye chung gi 'bum 'bri ba'i yon bdag mig na ba la sems gsum gyi khrid byas pas sos kyang gsung*// // 631) ༄// rdo rje 'chang nas tshig don gyi brgyud pa sel ma zhugs pa 'o skol 'di las med gsungs pa// yang 'di skad du gsung ste/ rtsa rngas pa'i las chos zhig la/ da lta bod kyi rgyal khams 'di na tshig gi brgyud pa la lhad ma zhugs te gi gu na ro gcig ma bsgyur ba/ don dam gyi brgyud pa la sel ma zhugs pa rdo rje 'chang nas bla ma rin po che yan chad la/ rtogs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud de chu gang byo 'o skol gyi 'di las med pa yin/ bka' gdams pa kun la yang jo bo byams pa nas rtogs pa 'di nas 'dir brgyud bya ba mi 'dug bdag med gnyis bden pa gnyis kyi bsam pa'i shes rab de rang la nan tan byed par 'dug gsung*/ de la rgya lcags ri ba nas brgyud pa'i rkyen bzhi ma de dang 'di'i go cha gnyis pa rang gi brgyud pa 'di yin te/ de la lta ba'i go cha ni dngos po'i gnas lugs kyi gshis de rang yin te/ nyon mongs dang rnam rtog gang du 'dug kyang skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa'i 'dug lugs spros bral de'o// de la shes rab kyi go cha ni de nyams su ji ltar len lugs yin te/

'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems yin zhes pa grub thob rnams kyi gsung mtha' che ba yin te/ chos thams cad bsam pa'i dkyil 'khor yin pas rnal 'byor pa la na tsha byung ste/ de dang por skye ma myong bar du gnas mi srid/ mtha' mar 'gag mi srid pas/ skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pa'i skye med yin te nad lam khyer/ gdon rgyal po dpe kar lta bu zhig gnod na dpe kar yang skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pas gdon lam khyer/ sa lam gyi rtogs pa yang skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong bas sa lam lam khyer/ sku gsum yang skye 'gag gnas gsum gyis stong pas sku gsum lam khyer yin te/ dang por skye ma myong ba chos sku/ bar du gnas mi srid pas longs sku/ mthar 'gag mi srid pas sprul sku ste/ dngos po rdul lam skra'i rtse mo tsam ma grub pas ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ sku bzhi po gcig pa'i sangs rgyas de la zer ba yin/ 'o na mtshan dpe'i sangs rgyas de ci yin snyam na/ byams pa snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang smon lam btab pa'i stobs kyis/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i sgom de rang gzhan snang du de ltar 'byung ba yin gsung*// // 632) ༄// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dang por byang chub tu thugs bskyed tshul// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ yang bsngo ba dang sems bskyed gcig tu 'jam dpal gyi zhing bkod pa las bshad pa la/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po nam mkha' bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa 'brug sgra dbyangs kyi rgyal po bya ba la/ bsod nams dpag tu med pa bsags pa'i bsod nams gang du bsngo'am snyam pa na/ lhas nam mkha' las bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngos shig pa'i sgra byung bas der bsngos pa la rgyu dang po byang chub tu sems bskyed pa mdzad par gda' gsung*// // 633) ༄// dbang rnam pa bzhi'i don las 'phros pa'i gdams pa// yang 'di skad bdag gis thos pa du gcig na/
